text: Does “all generated code” include the generated resolver and every other generator-emitted type, or only formatter classes?
options: Formatter classes only; decorating the object, string-key, enum, and union formatter templates is sufficient.
Every generated type; the generated resolver and any other emitted top-level types must also receive the guarded attribute.
why_it_matters: Under formatter-only scope, the change satisfies the requested coverage exclusion and the Formatters-only test filter is appropriate. Under every-generated-type scope, omitting the resolver leaves generated code uncovered by the attribute, so this is a high-severity requirement gap and the tests must include resolver outputs.
